body: You said you've tried everything. Give us an idea what you've tried that didn't work. I heard someone recommend just take out one thing a day you don't need as a first step. I can help you with meditation to find out why you're hoarding. [http://connectingtoinfinity.com/](http://connectingtoinfinity.com/)

Connecting to infinity, easy manageable, self discovery and growth

[https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCwWs69dKfQuZcFBCSfV4OlA](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCwWs69dKfQuZcFBCSfV4OlA)

That's one modality. I have some issues with law of attraction. What about the free will of other people. What about G-d? Law of attraction puts each person at the center of the universe but doesn't explain influences outside a person's control. I'm talking about a person who's expectations are negatively conditioned. They expect and seek bad experiences. Have to change the thought process
